opening.argument: The presentation promises unlimited income, financial freedom, and rapid earning outcomes, stating that 330 people reached 350 USD per week in only nine months. It also makes clear that income comes from recommendations and “building the structure of people,” linking the financial claims to recruitment and a tiered participant network. The invitation is an active enrollment pathway: viewers are told to click “I want to earn money,” submit their name and email, and enter the program as partners. The displayed “Get started NOW” prompt and claim that OneCoin is “The fastest growing crypto-currency in the world” reinforce an urgent promotional pitch, not criticism or analysis. Together, these earnings promises, recruitment structure, and direct registration instructions establish the nature of the offer.
